en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
I see right through your plans, Shuichi...

Do you think you can fool me by showing
off your cooking skills?

This is why degenerate males are so...!
Just die already!

That sounds great! I was just thinking
of getting something sweet to eat!

Although, it's a shame it's not with Himiko...
Oh well, can't be helped.

I'll eat some sweets with you,
so you better be grateful.

You're not planning to slip anything in my
drink and take advantage of me, are you?

Either way, I refuse to eat or drink with
a male.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Tenko looks deep in thought...
